chunks: Your assertion that since the birth of the Master of the Age until this day, which is a long period of time, no one knows his location and residence, nor does anyone reliable brings any news about him. This is extraordinary,
because everyone else who underwent hiding from an oppressor due to fear of his life or other reasons, he does not go into a very lengthy hiding and it does not take more than twenty years.
Likewise, he does not hide from everyone the place of his hiding
and some of his trusted followers and his family does know his location and brings news of his meeting.
Your belief is very different from that.

key_terms.صَاحِبُ الزَّمَانِ: Master of the Age (referring to the Twelfth Imam)

ai.seo_question: What is the argument against the long occultation of the Imam of the Age?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi addresses the rationalizes the prolonged, total concealment (al-ghaybah al-kubra) of Imam al-Mahdi by distinguishing it from the temporary hiding of previous Imams, arguing that divine wisdom permits a unique mode of existence where the Imam remains known yet unseen. This counters the objection that such an extended period without reliable news is unnatural, asserting instead that it is a specific divine decree (hukm ilahi) rather than an anomaly. The text underscores the theological shift from a period of active guidance to one of waiting, where the Imam’s presence is maintained despite physical invisibility.
